Paragraph: "He, this breeze is thus a happy one for touch, carrying a coolant and the fragrance like that of the sandalwood, and this breezing is a merited one and a fatigue remover...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Physical fatigue and emotional exhaustion from wandering in the wilderness.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama acknowledges the therapeutic, cooling, and fatigue-relieving properties of the fragrant breeze.
Outcome/Resolution: He finds temporary physical relief through the natural environment.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Emotional Regulation: Somatic Relief, Stress Reduction, Sensory Soothing

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Punya Gandha (Virtuous fragrance that removes fatigue and purifies the mind)
Shrama-Apanayana (Relief of physical and mental weariness)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Fragrance is associated with spiritual merit (Punya). The breeze acts as a divine grace carrying merit to refresh and relieve weary souls.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Somatic grounding: using pleasant tactile and olfactory sensations (cool sandalwood breeze) to alleviate physical fatigue and soothe stress.
